stories.title: Packers star RB Jacobs formally charged by DA
stories.summary: Packers running back Josh Jacobs was charged with misdemeanor battery and misdemeanor criminal damage to property, according to Wisconsin court records.

stories.title: Kubiak mum on Vegas' QB as Mendoza struggles
stories.summary: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak refused to name a regular-season starter after Thursday's preseason finale, although his utilization hints at Kirk Cousins getting the call in Week 1.

stories.title: ACC joins other P4 conferences in banning pros
stories.summary: The ACC passed a resolution Thursday banning professionals from returning to college in football, plus men's and women's basketball, joining the other Power 4 conferences in setting forth eligibility enforcement.

stories.title: McCarthy says Steelers' 4 QBs have earned spots
stories.summary: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said all four of the team's quarterbacks have earned roster spots, saying, "We got two veterans that we can win with, and we got two young guys that we're excited about the future."

stories.title: 'This is mine': Sale tops 100 mph, goes distance
stories.summary: Chris Sale threw his two fastest pitches since 2018, both to Shohei Ohtani, in his first complete game since 2019 as the Braves clinched a sweep of the Dodgers.
